page.layout: One title page. Title block at the top, centred, with the printer's device (woodcut with mottoes) in the middle, and the imprint at the bottom. No running head, no page number. Handwritten ink additions at top right and above the device, and show-through from the reverse, are not transcribed.
page.notes: The device is a woodcut of a printing workshop with a press and a compositor, framed by the mottoes SAPIENTER AGAS (top), QUICQUID AGAS (left), RESPICE FINEM (right), with PRELUM on the press bar and TYPOGRAPHICUM below. The ornament between "IN PINDARI" and "OLYMPIA" is a printer's flower. The handwritten "Lausanne", the handwritten "Authore Benedicto Aretio Bernensi" and the pencil/ink "1. 2." at top right are manuscript annotations, not printed text, and are left out. The ghost text on the page is show-through from the reverse and is left out.
